run_cross_entropy_forward: run the CrossEntropyCriterion forward method to compute loss for a given sample and model
compute_cross_entropy_loss: compute the cross entropy loss using nll_loss on log-probabilities and target tokens
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training by summing loss, tokens, and sentences
review_cross_entropy_criterion: review the CrossEntropyCriterion class and its forward, compute_loss, and aggregate_logging_outputs methods
refactor_compute_loss: refactor the compute_loss method to support a different reduction strategy or loss function
